product.title: Heart of Downtown Portland Food Tour

description.text: Explore downtown Portland on a guided food tour with tastings at local favorites across the city center. A guide leads a walking route through central districts while sharing Portland food culture, neighborhood history, and stories behind each stop.

highlights: Guided downtown Portland food tasting tour
Multiple food stops across central neighborhoods
Walking route with local guide commentary
Small-group format for a personal experience
Sample Portland specialties at curated stops

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.
